opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search
opportunities.description: On Ryanair.com, search for a flight by choosing origin airport (country then airport), destination airport, depart/return dates, passenger count, then clicking Search and selecting flights.
steps: Click From field, pick origin country then airport
Click To field, pick destination country then airport
Choose depart date (and return date for return trip) in calendar
Open passengers dropdown and set adults count
Select outbound and return flights (Select buttons)

instances.values: Dublin -> Athens, depart Sun 2 Apr, return Wed 5 Apr, 1 adult; flight selection ~1070-1084
Dublin -> Malta, depart Sat 22 Apr, 2 adults
Dublin -> Paris Beauvais, depart 26 Apr, return 2 May, 2 adults (promo code field tried)
Tel Aviv -> Venice Treviso, depart 9 May, return 16 May, 1 adult; flights selected

opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, search a destination with a date, then open a top result and view its availability/ticket selection.
steps: Click Select your dates and pick date
Optionally apply filters (free cancellation, category, city) and sort by Most popular
Choose date and ticket quantities, click Next
